summary: Layer 1B expands the investable universe around nuclear-grade manufacturing and advanced fuel/fabrication chokepoints rather than reactor developers. The two-lane result keeps BWX Technologies as the direct reference name, then adds Curtiss-Wright, Centrus Energy, and MISTRAS as underfollowed or second-order candidates tied to qualified components, HALEU enrichment, pumps/valves/control systems, and inspection/NDE gates. The strongest underfollowed discovery candidate for this node is MISTRAS because nuclear inspection and NDE are certification/compliance gates rather than obvious SMR exposure. Curtiss-Wright is larger than the preferred small/mid-cap range but included because its nuclear component exposure appears unusually direct. Centrus is included as an adjacent fuel-cycle bottleneck rather than a component fabricator.
